key_insight: A multi-modal temporal attention model combines welding images and sound to detect hidden fillet-joint defects in real time with near-perfect performance.
engineering_relevance: This approach can reduce post-weld inspection effort, prevent rework, and improve reliability in automated Gas Metal Arc Welding systems.
method: Trains a deep learning defect detector on synchronized welding image and audio data from an industrial collaborative robot.
Uses temporal attention to focus on the most informative moments and features across modalities.
Applies explainable AI to identify which image regions and sound spectrogram areas drive each defect prediction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the attention module improved F1 score to 0.99 on internal defect detection tasks.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and representativeness of the collected industrial dataset, so generalization to different weld setups should be validated.
paper_title: Explainable Temporal Attention-based Defect Detection For Fillet Joints in Real-Time Gas Metal Arc Welding Based on Multi-modal Data
